chunk.content: In a Taiwan market study, all 11 products sold as snapper that were substituted were confirmed by DNA to be Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus).
chunk.source_quote: The substituted snappers are the largest mislabel category, where all 11 substituted snappers are molecularly confirmed to be tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus, Table 1).

source.title: Investigating seafood substitution problems and consequences in Taiwan using molecular barcoding and deep microbiome profiling (doi:10.1038/s41598-020-79070-y)
